info.name: Google Chrome Management Telemetry Devices API
info.description:
The Chrome Management API provides programmatic access to manage Chrome browser deployments and ChromeOS devices in enterprise environments. It enables administrators to retrieve telemetry data from managed devices, query information about installed apps and extensions, generate reports on browser and device usage, and manage Chrome policies at scale. The API is part of the Google Workspace Admin suite and requires appropriate admin privileges and OAuth 2.0 authentication scopes.

Contact Support:
 Name: Google Chrome Enterprise Support

query.description: Fields to include in the response.
Maximum number of results to return. Maximum and default value is 100.
Token to specify next page in the result set.
Filter to restrict results. Supports filtering by serial number, device ID, org unit, and timestamps. Example: serial_number=ABC123 AND timestamp>2024-01-01T00:00:00Z

Fields to include in the response. Use this to request specific telemetry data categories such as cpuInfo, cpuStatusReport, memoryInfo, memoryStatusReport, networkInfo, osUpdateStatus, storageInfo, storageStatusReport, batteryInfo, batteryStatusReport, networkDiagnosticsReport, and more.
